mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_access_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
SELECT FROM t_access_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_access_tenant t ORDER BY t.tenant_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: m.tenant_id tenantId,m.member_id memberId,m.account_id accountId,a.email_masked emailMasked, m.member_type memberType,m.status memberStatus,a.status accountStatus,m.create_time createdAt,m.update_time updatedAt, a.realm,a.account_type accountType
FROM t_tenant_member m LEFT JOIN t_user_account a ON a.account_id=m.account_id
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY m.member_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND (a.account_id IS NULL OR a.account_id<=0 OR m.member_id<=0 OR BINARY a.realm!='CUSTOMER' OR BINARY a.account_type!='HUMAN' OR BINARY a.status NOT IN ('PENDING_VERIFICATION','ACTIVE','DISABLED','CLOSED') OR BINARY m.member_type NOT IN ('OWNER','ADMIN','MEMBER') OR BINARY m.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','REVOKED'))
mapper.sql: FROM t_tenant_member_role g LEFT JOIN t_role r ON r.role_id=g.role_id
JOIN t_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=g.role_id LEFT JOIN t_permission p ON p.permission_id=rp.permission_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} AND (g.tenant_id!=#{tenantId} OR r.role_id IS NULL OR r.role_id<=0 OR g.tenant_member_role_id<=0 OR BINARY g.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','REVOKED','EXPIRED') OR BINARY r.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','INACTIVE') OR g.effective_from IS NULL OR (g.effective_to IS NOT NULL AND g.effective_to<=g.effective_from) OR COALESCE(((BINARY r.tenant_scope='PLATFORM' AND r.tenant_id IS NULL AND BINARY r.scope_key='PLATFORM' AND BINARY g.role_scope_key='PLATFORM') OR (BINARY r.tenant_scope='TENANT' AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND BINARY r.scope_key=CAST(#{tenantId} AS CHAR) AND BINARY g.role_scope_key=BINARY r.scope_key)),0)=0)

SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} AND (p.permission_id IS NULL OR p.permission_id<=0 OR rp.role_permission_id<=0 OR BINARY p.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','INACTIVE') OR BINARY rp.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','REVOKED'))
mapper.sql: g.tenant_member_role_id grantId,g.role_id roleId,r.role_code roleCode,r.role_name roleName, r.tenant_scope roleScope,r.tenant_id roleTenantId,r.status roleStatus,g.status grantStatus, g.effective_from effectiveFrom,g.effective_to effectiveTo

(r.status='INACTIVE') roleInactive,(g.status='REVOKED') grantRevoked, (g.effective_from>#{asOf}) grantNotStarted,(g.status='EXPIRED' OR (g.effective_to IS NOT NULL AND g.effective_to<=#{asOf})) grantExpired
mapper.select: SELECT , WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY g.tenant_member_role_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_tenant_member_role WHERE tenant_member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.sql: p.permission_id permissionId,p.permission_code permissionCode,p.resource_type resourceType,p.action_code actionCode,p.status permissionStatus
mapper.select: SELECT permissionId,permissionCode,resourceType,actionCode,permissionStatus,COUNT(*) sourceCount, SUM(NOT(roleInactive OR grantRevoked OR grantNotStarted OR grantExpired OR rolePermissionRevoked OR permissionInactive)) effectiveSourceCount, MAX(roleInactive) roleInactive,MAX(grantRevoked) grantRevoked,MAX(grantNotStarted) grantNotStarted, MAX(grantExpired) grantExpired,MAX(rolePermissionRevoked) rolePermissionRevoked,MAX(permissionInactive) permissionInactive FROM (SELECT , JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_id WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY rp.permission_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}) selected ON selected.permission_id=p.permission_id WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId}) facts GROUP BY permissionId,permissionCode,resourceType,actionCode,permissionStatus ORDER BY permissionId
SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE g.tenant_member_id=#{memberId} AND rp.permission_id=#{permissionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_access_tenant SET security_status=#{securityStatus},version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND tenant_type IN ('CLIENT','PARTNER')
